description: Lessons from real three.js and react-three-fiber projects: symptom, cause, fix and how to test it. Pass `error` with a console or build message to get the lessons that explain it; `rule` with a review rule id for why it matters; `query` with words ('textures washed out', 'shadow cut off', 'model invisible'); `topic` to list one topic; `id` for one lesson in full. With `id` and `verdict` (helped or wrong) it records whether the lesson fit, which ranks lessons on this machine. Lessons you kept with three_lesson_add are included.

error.description: a message as it was printed

verdict.description: with id: did the lesson fit?
